Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misunderstood the nature and consequences of somatic cell mutations. The error was in treating the potential for transmission to offspring (Option D) as a way somatic mutations harm the organism, despite somatic mutations occurring only in non-reproductive cells, meaning they do not get passed to offspring (which requires germline mutations). The Planner also incorrectly ruled out Option C, “leading to tumors in tissue,” which is the direct and harmful effect of somatic mutations. This indicates a misalignment with the fundamental understanding of how somatic mutations can impact an organism, leading to the selection of the wrong answer. This fits a pattern of Error Signature from Example 1, where there is failure in aligning with the ground truth and misunderstanding of somatic mechanisms.
